defaults.source: packs/nl/defaults.json: Energiewet, article 2.30, first paragraph, d: shared per imbalance settlement period, 15 minutes by the Begrippencode elektriciteit.
The Energiewet leaves the locality of sharing to an order in council (article 2.30, second paragraph), and the Energiebesluit sets none: packs/nl decides no perimeter.

operators.source: packs/nl/grid.json: Westland Infra runs the grid of the municipality of Westland (Gebiedsindelingscode elektriciteit, article 5, seventh paragraph, a), inside Zuid-Holland, which is Stedin's.

settlement.source: The proportional key of the sharing_example engine worked by hand: at each hour the energy shared is the smaller of what the participants feed in and what they take; each receives in proportion to its offtake. At 09:00, 10:00 and 12:00 the houses take no more than the roof feeds in and receive all they take (4, 6 and 6 kWh); at 11:00 they take 10 kWh and the roof feeds in 8: house A receives 8 × 6/10 = 4.8, house B 8 × 4/10 = 3.2.

kpis.source: 13 kWh taken less the 11.8 the key shared to house A.
